correctness.rationale: The coarea Jacobian is proportional to 1-h² and normalizes to f_H(h)=3(1-h²)/2. Area-biased angle integrals J0=3π/8 and Jacute=3π/16 were independently quadrature-checked. With one facet plane at h→0, containment of the origin has conditional limit 1/2 on acute face shapes and zero otherwise; a uniform fourth vertex contributes another 1/2. Thus each facet contributes (3/8)t. For distinct facets the second-plane zero-height event is null conditional on a nondegenerate first-plane limit, giving o(t) overlap by dominated convergence. Four-face union coefficient is 3/2, normalized by Wendel P(E)=1/8 to coefficient 12. Shape, unique-face label and scaled height converge jointly in TV by density convergence and Scheffé. The saved checker recomputed actual face plane distances, not just formal constants.

value.rationale: The conditional clearance and endpoint derivative address the natural open four-cap coverage interval singled out by Finch; the acute marked limit identifies which exceptional face destroys coverage. This is more than re-normalization of a known scalar marginal: it proves negligible simultaneous facet contacts and the limiting conditional geometry, useful for near-critical covering calculations.
